Professional Summary
    Results-driven Product Owner and Business Analyst with 15+ years of experience in the banking domain, specializing in Trade Finance, Payments, and Compliance. Proven expertise in product strategy, product roadmap development, backlog management, trade digitization, AML/TBML Compliance screening, and PSD2/Open Banking APIs. Adept at Agile methodologies, translating complex business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications and innovative, market-ready solutions and driving cross-functional collaboration to deliver high-impact products.

Product Ownership, Strategy & Roadmap Management (Trade Finance, Payments, Compliance),Product Metrics, KPIs Tracking
Trade Digitization (OCR), AML/TBML Screening

Professional Experience
Pelican.ai (Ace Software Solutions) — Product Owner	2015 – Present
Defined and executed product vision and roadmap for trade digitization and compliance products, leveraging OCR technology to automate document processing and enhance TBML screening and accuracy, significantly improving operational efficiency and regulatory adherence.
Delivered robust TBML screening and payments solutions by conducting detailed requirement analysis, prioritizing features based on client impact, and incorporating stakeholder feedback to ensure alignment with compliance standards and business goals.
Designed and implemented Trade AML solutions by translating complex business requirements into scalable product features, enabling financial institutions to proactively detect and mitigate money laundering risks.
Designed and Implemented key market initiatives including SEPA Instant, ISO 20022, PSD2, Open Banking, and SWIFT GPI, ensuring strategic alignment with evolving regulatory frameworks and customer expectations.
Prioritized and managed product backlog in JIRA, creating user stories, and acceptance criteria, resulting in 30% faster time-to-market, improve team collaboration, and enhancing responsiveness to client needs and market changes.
Implemented comprehensive compliance rules for Sanction Screening across payment platforms, including OFAC, AML, and Red Flags, ensuring full regulatory compliance and minimizing risk exposure.
Architected and deployed a Payments Gateway solution for a major US media client, optimizing transaction workflows and achieving a 35% reduction in operational costs through automation and system integration.
Streamlined internal workflows by establishing a centralized repository for documentation and collaboration, improving transparency and accelerating development across cross-functional teams.
Coordinated closely with project managers to monitor development progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery of product milestones, maintaining high standards of quality and client satisfaction.
Built and nurtured strong client relationships by identifying operational inefficiencies, proposing tailored solutions, and ensuring continuous engagement to support long-term success and product adoption.
